DropdownMenuProps.description: These props are directly passed to the underlying DropdownMenu component, customizing its behavior. It is also the way to reach the menu's PopperComponent, PaperComponent and placement.

InputDropdownProps.description: These props are directly passed to the underlying InputDropdown component, customizing its behavior.

buttonPosition.description: Specifies the position of the Apply/Cancel buttons at the Dropdown footer.

buttons.description: When set to true, a set of Apply/Cancel buttons will be displayed at the Dropdown footer.

closeOnBlur.description: When set to true, the Dropdown will automatically close when a click occurs outside of it.

isSearchAutoFocus.description: Puts the cursor in the search input as the menu opens. It only applies alongside search.

multiple.description: If `true`, `value` must be an array and the menu will support multiple selections.

options.description: An array of options to be displayed as MenuItems within the Dropdown.

search.description: When set to true, a search input is displayed at the top of the Dropdown for filtering options.

title.description: A heading shown at the top of the menu.

isTriggerChangeOnOptionClick.description: When set to true, changes in Dropdown selections are applied in real-time to the react state.

value.description:
The value of the autocomplete.

The value must have reference equality with the option in order to be selected.
You can customize the equality behavior with the `isOptionEqualToValue` prop.

InputDropdownComponent.description: The component used to render the Dropdown trigger button.
